humanizer.note: Humanizer settings: Standard tone, Strong; the site tries ten rewrite variants and keeps the one its own detector scores lowest. All texts are from the held-out test split. The full-rewrite test used a different random set of 60 modern-chatbot texts, so its starting rate differs. Because Latent's detector is tuned to rarely flag people, edited text slides under its cutoff more easily than under a detector that flags aggressively. The full-AI-rewrite columns for Latent Write were scored with the previous detector version (the rewrite texts were not in the training-data package); the humanizer columns use the current detector.
